name: Shenyang Chemical Co., Ltd
summary: Shenyang Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of chlor-alkali chemical products, petrochemical products, and new chemical materials. It operates through the following business segments: Chlor-alkali chemical industry, Petrochemical industry, and New chemical materials. Its products include paste resin, gasoline, propylene, caustic soda, acrylates and esters, polyethylene, and polyether. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Shenyang, China.
